scope: AI-TOD-v2 seed-0 YOLO26s discovery sample only; this is not yet the prospective lockbox contract

radius.search: forward coarse scan to the first observed base-identity same-to-changed bracket, followed by forward fine scan within that bracket

rho_R.pair: fixed base loss-active candidate A and fixed base native runner B

numeric_contract.tie_rule: native ordering is normative; exact float32 q ties are an explicit undefined/numerical-boundary state rather than a substantive rank event
numeric_contract.precision_guardrail: reported radius precision may not exceed the fine step

base_box_domain: A continuous legal trajectory is defined only for focal GT boxes fully inside the 800x800 model input at radius zero. Base-outside GTs are counted and excluded without clipping.
image_boundary_guard: If an otherwise valid terminal image-boundary censor point rounds outside in native float32 arithmetic, move only that terminal point inward using the first successful guard in 8,16,32,64,128 times float32 epsilon times max image dimension; record the applied pixel guard.

o2m_empty_set_contract.empty_empty: structural state; Jaccard and retention null
o2m_empty_set_contract.empty_to_nonempty: structural transition; Jaccard zero, base retention null
o2m_empty_set_contract.nonempty_to_empty: structural transition; Jaccard and base retention zero

validation.production_repeatability: exact SHA-256 match for event CSV, curve CSV, and selected-images CSV across two runs
validation.independent_reference_smoke: 48/48 trajectories, zero mismatches, maximum event-radius difference 0 after explicit base-box-domain validation
